note: M3's own tuning procedure is leave-one-season-out over the five clean market seasons (2019, 2020, 2022-24), which are also its test window; the plan prescribes this. No season <= 2017 has a preseason market line, so the shipped mkt+td pipeline cannot run there. Every configuration in the grid below is scored in a single run and the LOSO choice is computed from it.

entries.what: pipeline check on 2019, 300 sims, k in {0.7,1.0,1.4}; printed only simulated quantities (league mean points, simulated SDs); no actual points read or scored

entries.multiplier_definition: k scales the whole team-strength SD: o_sd, d_sd (= k*net_sd/sqrt2) and the in-season drift SD (k*drift); league level mu re-set with the Jensen term at k^2*var, ratings re-solved (freeze.main order)
entries.scores: sample CRPS of raw season points over games played; 80% coverage = actual in [p10, p90] inclusive (season.summarise band)
entries.loso: for each season, k = argmin pooled CRPS on the other four seasons; held-out season scored at that k; baseline k = 1.0

entries.what: single run of the full grid on the five clean market seasons; LOSO choice computed from it; no reruns
